itm301-r1.title: ITM301: Ch 1 + first D2L practice attempt (baseline)
itm301-r1.detail: Blurt Ch 1 (network models, services, hardware, OSI), then take the practice quiz once just to see where you are. D2L → ITM301 → Midterm Exam Practice. 60 random questions from an 80-question bank.

itm301-r2.title: ITM301: Ch 2 + Ch 3 (cabling, IP addresses, ports, sockets)
itm301-r2.detail: Structured cabling + diagrams, then IPv4/IPv6, APIPA, DHCP, ports and sockets. Do the Study tab topic drills after.

itm301-r3.title: ITM301: Ch 4 (core protocols, encryption, remote access)
itm301-r3.detail: TCP/UDP, ICMP, ARP, TTL, IPsec vs TLS, SSH vs Telnet, VPN types.

itm301-r4.title: ITM301: Ch 5 (twisted pair, pinouts, fiber)
itm301-r4.detail: Sections 5.2.3–5.2.7, 5.3.2, 5.3.3, 5.3.6 only. STP/UTP, cable cats, T568A/B, SMF vs MMF.

itm301-r5.title: ITM301: Ch 6 (Wi-Fi security + tools)
itm301-r5.detail: Sections 6.4.1–6.4.5 and 6.5.1. WPA2/WPA3, Personal vs Enterprise, evil twin, spectrum analyzer.

itm301-r6.title: ITM301: D2L practice attempt #2 + redo what you missed
itm301-r6.detail: D2L → ITM301 → Midterm Exam Practice. 60 random questions from an 80-question bank.

itm301-r7.title: ITM301: textbook review + scenario questions, Ch 1–6
itm301-r7.detail: End-of-chapter questions, only the sections on the midterm. Your prof specifically recommended these.

itm301-r8.title: ITM301: D2L practice #3 (aim for 80%+)
itm301-r8.detail: D2L → ITM301 → Midterm Exam Practice. 60 random questions from an 80-question bank.

itm301-r9.title: ITM301: D2L practice #4 (aim for 90%+)
itm301-r9.detail: D2L → ITM301 → Midterm Exam Practice. 60 random questions from an 80-question bank.

itm301-r10.title: ITM301: night-before skim + weak spots
itm301-r10.detail: Must-know list in the Study tab + anything you keep missing. Bed early, exam is 10 AM Saturday at TRS 1-067.

pcs-r1.title: PCS181: review Intro + Scales of the Universe
pcs-r1.detail: Blurt, then the Study tab drills for those topics.

pcs-r2.title: PCS181: review Gravity & orbits (Kepler, Newton)
pcs-r2.detail: Kepler’s 3 laws, inverse-square gravity, why orbiting = free fall.

pcs-r3.title: PCS181: review Light & telescopes
pcs-r3.detail: EM spectrum order, Wien, Kirchhoff’s 3 spectra, Doppler, aperture, why space telescopes.

pcs-r4.title: PCS181: review The Sun
pcs-r4.detail: Fusion in the core, layers, hydrostatic equilibrium, sunspots, 11-year cycle.

pcs-r5.title: PCS181: review the Solar System (Lecture 9)
pcs-r5.detail: Nebular theory, frost line, rocky vs giant planets.

pcs-r6.title: PCS181: short-answer practice (all 9, out loud)
pcs-r6.detail: Study tab → PCS181 → Short-answer practice. 2–4 sentences each. Short answers are 10 of 40 marks.

pcs-r7.title: PCS181: full mock + OpenStax review questions
pcs-r7.detail: Mock test in the Study tab, then OpenStax Ch 3, 5, 6, 15 review questions (links in the Study tab).

itm200-r3.title: ITM200: classes 1 + 3 (basics + conditionals), trace code on paper

itm301-mid.name: ITM301 Midterm
itm301-mid.note: Sat Oct 24, 10–11:30 AM, TRS 1-067. 60 MCQs in 90 min. Modules 1–5 (Ch 1–6 selected sections). Do the D2L Midterm Exam Practice bank until you hit 90%+.

pcs181-mid.name: PCS181 Midterm
pcs181-mid.note: In class, starts 10 min after the hour, 90 min. 30 MCQ + short answers (10 marks). No calculators or study aids. Covers lectures up to and including Lecture 9 (Oct 9).

itm200-mid.name: ITM200 Midterm
itm200-mid.note: Fri Oct 30, 12 PM, room KHE321C. 90 min, 40 multiple-choice on paper. Covers classes 1–6 (through functions).

ecn503-mid.name: ECN503 Midterm
ecn503-mid.note: In class. Covers lectures 1–5 + Oct 14, bolded readings, Poor Economics Ch 2–3. Sick? Email Li before the test and hand in a medical note within 5 working days, or it’s a zero.
